reading: Russia has released a 74-year-old American who was jailed for purportedly fighting on behalf of Ukraine.
The Russian president confirmed during an early Wednesday meeting that Stephen Hubbard had been transported to Pulkovo Airport.
Donald Trump stated that the release followed a direct request he made to the Russian leader last week.
He added that the release did not require any reciprocal concessions from the United States.
American news outlets reported that the elderly man was in poor health and expected to be flown to Texas for medical care.
Trump defended his move to pause impending sanctions against Russia, arguing that enforcing them would have brought diplomatic discussions to a complete halt.
Steve Witkoff thanked Putin for a deal struck with Washington earlier this month to import Russian diesel.
This diesel agreement infuriated Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky, triggering a tumultuous period of deteriorating relations.
Witkoff also urged Putin to consider resuming trilateral peace talks, seeking an end to a conflict that grinds on into its fifth year.
Meanwhile, Kyiv accused Washington of withholding vital intelligence, a claim the US firmly rejected as scandalous.
However, Zelensky confirmed that intelligence sharing had resumed after constructive talks with American officials in Oslo.

vocabulary.definition: As appears or is stated to be true, though not definitively proven.
Given, felt, or done in return; involving mutual exchange.
About to happen; looming or fast approaching.
Made someone extremely angry and impatient.
Characterised by intense disorder, turbulence, or confusion.
Becoming progressively worse over a period of time.
Involving three separate parties, countries, or groups.
Continues for a long time in a slow, tedious, and destructive way.
Causing outrage by a perceived offence against morality or established norms.
Serving a useful purpose; tending to build up or improve relations.

entries.ja: 真実であると見せかけられている、または述べられているが、決定的に証明されていないこと。
entries.ko: 사실인 것처럼 보이거나 주장되지만, 결정적으로 증명되지는 않은 상태.
entries.zh-Hans: 表面上或据称是真的，但尚未得到明确证实。
entries.es: Según parece o se afirma que es verdad, aunque no esté probado de manera definitiva.
entries.pt-BR: Conforme aparenta ou é declarado ser verdade, embora não comprovado de forma definitiva.
entries.fr: Tel que cela apparaît ou est déclaré être vrai, bien que cela ne soit pas définitivement prouvé.
entries.de: So wie es scheint oder angegeben wird, wahr zu sein, obwohl es nicht endgültig bewiesen ist.

entries.ja: 見返りとして与えられたり、感じられたり、行われたりすること。相互の交換を伴う。
entries.ko: 보답으로 주어지거나, 느껴지거나, 행해지는; 상호 교환을 포함하는.
entries.zh-Hans: 作为回报给予、感受到或做出的；涉及相互交换。
entries.es: Que se da, se siente o se hace a cambio; que implica un intercambio mutuo.
entries.pt-BR: Dado, sentido ou feito em troca; envolvendo uma troca mútua.
entries.fr: Donné, ressenti ou fait en retour; impliquant un échange mutuel.
entries.de: Als Gegenleistung gegeben, gefühlt oder getan; einen gegenseitigen Austausch betreffend.

entries.ja: 間もなく起こる、迫っている、または急速に近づいていること。
entries.ko: 곧 일어날 것 같은; 임박하거나 빠르게 다가오는.
entries.zh-Hans: 即将发生；迫近或快速临近。
entries.es: Que está a punto de suceder; inminente o que se acerca rápidamente.
entries.pt-BR: Que está prestes a acontecer; iminente ou que se aproxima rapidamente.
entries.fr: Sur le point d'arriver; imminent ou qui approche à grands pas.
entries.de: Unmittelbar bevorstehend; sich abzeichnend oder schnell nähernd.

entries.ja: 誰かを非常に怒らせ、我慢できなくさせた。
entries.ko: 누군가를 극도로 화나게 하고 참을성 없게 만들었다.
entries.zh-Hans: 使某人极其愤怒和不耐烦。
entries.es: Hacer que alguien se enoje o se impaciente extremadamente.
entries.pt-BR: Deixar alguém extremamente zangado e impaciente.
entries.fr: Mettre quelqu'un dans une colère extrême et le rendre impatient.
entries.de: Jemanden extrem wütend und ungeduldig gemacht.

entries.ja: 激しい無秩序、混乱、または困惑によって特徴づけられる。
entries.ko: 극심한 무질서, 혼란 또는 동요로 특징지어지는.
entries.zh-Hans: 以剧烈混乱、骚动或困惑为特征。
entries.es: Caracterizado por un intenso desorden, turbulencia o confusión.
entries.pt-BR: Caracterizado por intensa desordem, turbulência ou confusão.
entries.fr: Caractérisé par un désordre intense, des troubles ou de la confusion.
entries.de: Gekennzeichnet durch intensive Unordnung, Turbulenzen oder Verwirrung.

entries.ja: 時間の経過とともに徐々に悪化していくこと。
entries.zh-Hans: 在一段时间内逐渐变差。
entries.es: Que se va volviendo progresivamente peor con el tiempo.
entries.pt-BR: Tornando-se progressivamente pior ao longo do tempo.
entries.fr: Devenir progressivement pire au fil du temps.
entries.de: Sich über einen Zeitraum hinweg zunehmend verschlechternd.

entries.ja: 3つの別々の当事者、国、またはグループが関与すること。
entries.ko: 세 개의 개별 당사자, 국가 또는 집단이 관련된.
entries.zh-Hans: 涉及三个独立的方面、国家或团体。
entries.es: Que involucra a tres partes, países o grupos separados.
entries.pt-BR: Envolvendo três partes, países ou grupos separados.
entries.fr: Qui implique trois parties, pays ou groupes distincts.
entries.de: Drei separate Parteien, Länder oder Gruppen betreffend.

entries.ja: ゆっくりと、うんざりするような、破壊的な方法で長い間続く。
entries.ko: 느리고 지루하며 파괴적인 방식으로 오랫동안 계속되다.
entries.zh-Hans: 以缓慢、乏味和破坏性的方式持续很长时间。
entries.es: Continuar durante mucho tiempo de una manera lenta, tediosa y destructiva.
entries.pt-BR: Continuar por muito tempo de uma forma lenta, tediosa e destrutiva.
entries.fr: Continuer pendant longtemps d'une manière lente, fastidieuse et destructrice.
entries.de: Hält auf langsame, mühsame und zerstörerische Weise über lange Zeit an.

entries.ja: 道徳や確立された規範に対する認識された違反によって憤慨を引き起こすこと。
entries.ko: 도덕성이나 확립된 규범에 대한 인지된 위반으로 분노를 유발하는.
entries.zh-Hans: 因被视为冒犯道德或既定规范而引起公愤的。
entries.es: Que causa indignación por una ofensa percibida contra la moralidad o las normas establecidas.
entries.pt-BR: Que causa indignação por uma ofensa percebida contra a moralidade o las normas establecidas.
entries.fr: Qui provoque l'indignation par une offense perçue contre la moralité ou les normes établies.
entries.de: Empörung hervorrufend durch einen wahrgenommenen Verstoß gegen Moral oder etablierte Normen.

entries.ja: 有用な目的を果たすこと。関係を築いたり改善したりする傾向がある。
entries.ko: 유용한 목적을 수행하는; 관계를 구축하거나 개선하는 경향이 있는.
entries.zh-Hans: 起到有益的作用；有助于建立或改善关系。
entries.es: Que sirve para un propósito útil; que tiende a construir o mejorar las relaciones.
entries.pt-BR: Que serve a um propósito útil; que tende a construir ou melhorar as relações.
entries.fr: Qui sert un but utile; qui tend à construire ou à améliorer les relations.
entries.de: Einem nützlichen Zweck dienend; darauf abzielend, Beziehungen aufzubauen oder zu verbessern.
